  • Class
    Description
    EgradxMdcScope
    Puts values into the logging MDC and, on EgradxMdcScope.close(), puts back exactly what was there before — so a pooled or virtual thread never carries one piece of work's ids into the next one's log lines.
    EgradxMeterRegistryMetrics
    EgradxMetrics over the application's Micrometer MeterRegistry.
    EgradxMetrics
    Counters, gauges and timers for what has no natural span — messages given up on, the size of a backlog, open connections.
    EgradxMetrics.Noop
     
    EgradxObservations
    The one way egradx code times an operation: each call is a Micrometer Observation, which becomes a timer when the application has a MeterRegistry and a span when it has a tracer too — and nothing at all when it has neither.
    EgradxTagRules
    What may be a metric name or a metric tag, checked on every call so that a mistake fails a test instead of taking down a metrics backend.
    EgradxTraceContext
    Where a piece of work came from, in a form that can be written into a database row or a message and picked up again later, on another thread or in another process.
